title: Luumi
summary: A tiny animated Mac cat that can chat, remember context, and help with Notes, Calendar, and Music when asked.
body:
An adorable animated native Mac assistant. Just a small, slightly sassy cat.

Luumi can use an AI gateway or local Ollama, with explicit actions for Notes, Calendar, and Music.

But mostly i just like how she sits in the way of everything and purrs when i pick her up to move her.
review_notes: Uses Luumi’s official website and social card supplied by Sebastien.

title: Magic Words
summary: A poetry playground where kids write a poem and watch the words come alive.
body: A children's poetry toy with animated words, a poem theater, and retro computer themes.
review_notes: Existing project social card and documented website URL. The current live site has not been checked.

title: Free Rangers
summary: A local food-shop app for browsing produce, building a basket, and repeating last week's order.
body: A progressive web app for a local food shop, with product browsing, baskets, and repeat orders.
review_notes: Public app icon only; no customer data or owner screens. No verified public website URL.

title: Read the Shift
summary: An interactive sailing visualization for making sense of wind shifts.
body: A visual way to explore sailing wind shifts and see how the changing wind affects the picture on the water.
review_notes: Needs a real screenshot of the selected Read the Shift visualization. Public Site version 3 was verified in the source research; interaction testing has not been repeated. This is not Race Around the Rock.

title: Salt Wind
summary: A 3D-printed model ship, from the hull and rigging to the tiny dinghies.
body:
A printed model ship, separate from Bon Vivant. The main single-filament print turned out well; the tiny dinghies sank.

The main model's flotation is still unverified, and the B variant is for display.
review_notes: Needs a photo of the actual finished print. Avoid using an earlier model rendering as a photograph or claiming it is a proven floating toy.

title: Grater repair
summary: A replacement handle for my wife's grandmother's grater. Repairing something worth keeping.
body: A replacement handle to repair my wife's grandmother's grater instead of replacing it.
review_notes: Needs a photo of the repaired grater or the correct final v04 handle. The intermediate visual predates the final revision.

title: Hotfoot Sailing
summary: A home for the Hotfoot fleet: boats, photographs, race reports, and events.
body: A sailing community website with a fleet registry, photographs, race reports, and an event board.
review_notes: Uses an existing public fleet photograph. The documented website URL has not been live-checked; no private submissions or contact data included.

title: Seb x Seb
summary: An experimental interview studio where an AI voice clone interviews me.
body: A local experiment in interviewing myself: an AI voice clone asks questions, and the real Seb answers.
review_notes: Needs a sanitized studio screenshot. No private recordings, voice uploads, or audio samples. Microphone/listening validation remains pending in the project README; no public demo URL.

title: Fibonacci hexagrams
summary: Visual experiments with Fibonacci sequences, nested hexagrams, and patterns in modular arithmetic.
body: Computational visualizations of Fibonacci sequences and nested hexagrams. An exploration of mathematical patterns, rather than a claim of peer-reviewed proof.
review_notes: Uses the recovered Fibonacci stars figure. No speculative claims from research notes; documented tests have not been rerun.

title: Osmosis in 3D
summary: An interactive 3D explainer for exploring osmosis, particles, and membranes.
body: An interactive explainer for visualizing osmosis in three dimensions. Particle sizes and reservoir behavior are illustrative.
review_notes: Needs recovery of the original osmosis-in-3d.html and a real screenshot. No recovered demo or public demo URL yet.

title: BKR straw lid
summary: A 3D-printed straw lid, shaped around an existing bottle's threads and straw.
body:
A replacement straw lid designed around an existing bottle. The original thread and straw fit worked well.

The later carry-loop and skirt revision is still a prototype.
review_notes: Needs the correct v04 preview or an actual print photo. Carrying strength and sealing have not been tested.
